title: Sharp Edges
text: Sharp Edges. This is just like one my friend has except for the extremely sharp edge along one side.  Almost cut myself putting it into the dishwasher.

product_metadata.title: Premium Grade Stainless Steel Spaetzle Maker with Comfort Grip Handle Traditional German Egg Noodle Maker
features: Want to make Spaetzle just like how Oma did? Make traditional German noodle dumplings at home with the KEISSCO Spaetzle maker.
Easy to use and serve up Spaetzle with meat, butter, sweet and sour dressings, or pioneer a new combination!
Plastic slider to prevent scratching of stainless steel and staining of the dough.
Has a soft santoprene handle for a non-slip grip.
Ideal for pans with a diameter of approx. 30 cm.
